A person's hand holds the bag steadily against a neutral background. (2) The scene shifts to a man in a black and white striped shirt sitting on a grey carpeted floor. He is examining the back of the package, pointing at the numerical codes near the barcode while a female narrator explains their significance. (3) The man proceeds to tear open the plastic packaging with his hands, revealing a bright orange, sphere-shaped bath bomb inside. (4) A young boy in a tan t-shirt is shown in a bathroom setting, holding the orange bath bomb and looking at it with excitement while talking to the adults. (5) The camera angle changes to a top-down view of a bathtub filled with clear water. A hand drops the orange bath bomb into the water, causing it to immediately fizz and release a vibrant orange-yellow dye into the water. (6) The bath bomb continues to dissolve rapidly, creating thick bubbles and foam. A hand reaches into the water to move the fizzing object around. (7) As the outer shell dissolves, a small yellow toy figure (the character Usagi) begins to emerge from the foam. (8) The final shots show the wet yellow figure held up close to the camera, followed by a cut back to the package illustrating the characters, confirming they found the secret one.
